about_the_game:
THE FEST-EVIL KILLER IS ON THE LOOSE!

Fall 1976 - Fresh off the events of Serial Cleaner, Bob finds himself backed into a corner. A detective with dirt on his past gives him a choice: help track down The Fest-Evil Killer or face the consequences. Now, with blood in the streets and confetti in the air, Bob must gather clues and clean up the chaos across festival-inspired crime scenes, all while staying one step ahead of the law.

The mess is bigger, the stakes are higher—time to sweep this case under the rug… or be buried in it.

BLOOD, CONFETTI AND A KILLER TO CATCH

Hunt down The Fest-Evil Killer across three crime-soaked celebrations:

- Chinese New Year

- Día de los Muertos

- Mardi Gras.

With blood on the streets and confetti in the air, every festival hides a mess only The Cleaner can handle.

GROOVE, DISGUISE, ESCAPE, REPEAT!

Tracking a killer is dirty work, but that doesn’t mean you can’t do it in style. Unlock fresh new outfits for Bob and groove to an all-new ‘70s-inspired soundtrack for each level.

Serial Cleaner: Blood & Confetti will be available to purchase on April 28th, 2025.

short_description: The work of a good cleaner is never done! Bob is back, forced to track down The Fest-Evil killer across three crime-ridden celebrations - Chinese New Year, Día de los Muertos, and Mardi Gras. Sneak, sweep, and survive in this stylish 2D stealth-action DLC. Tread carefully… the dead are watching.
